acceptanceCriteria: Each source has a requirement and a fixture showing it widens reach.
A test proves runtime coverage can never turn UNKNOWN into NONE.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. Reach is only the app map today. V1 joins the TJAA module graph, runtime coverage that may only widen reach (never produce NONE), API contract joins, and passes the ANL ledger instead of nil.
title: CCE V1: wider reach sources (TJAA module graph, runtime coverage, API contract joins)
